Develop automation and self-service solutions to improve endpoint management and user experience. Create and maintain endpoint configuration, compliance, and security policies. Patch & Vulnerability Management Test, validate, and deploy operating system, driver, firmware, and application updates. Assess software patches for potential business impact prior to enterprise deployment. Develop deployment schedules and rollout strategies. Monitor patch compliance and remediation activities. Partner with Cybersecurity teams to address endpoint vulnerabilities and reduce risk exposure. Security & Compliance Support Zero Trust and endpoint security initiatives. Ensure workstation configurations comply with organizational security standards and regulatory requirements. Partner with Security teams to implement endpoint protection, encryption, device compliance, and conditional access controls. Participate in security reviews, audits, and compliance assessments. Operational Support Serve as Tier 3 escalation support for complex workstation-related incidents and problems. Perform root cause analysis and drive permanent corrective actions. Engage vendors and manufacturers to resolve product defects and technical issues. Support major incidents impacting endpoint services. Documentation & Process Improvement Develop and maintain technical standards, procedures, runbooks, and knowledge articles. Maintain endpoint architecture documentation and hardware standards catalogs. Continuously improve workstation deployment, support, and lifecycle processes. Identify opportunities for automation and operational efficiency. Project Participation Lead or participate in endpoint modernization initiatives. Support workstation-related workstreams for mergers, acquisitions, office openings, and technology refresh projects. Collaborate with Infrastructure, Cloud, Networking, Cybersecurity, and Service Desk teams to deliver endpoint solutions. OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Technology evaluation and decision-making. Project and change management. Process improvement mindset. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to balance security, usability, and operational requirements. Vendor management and stakeholder engagement. Documentation and knowledge management. Customer-focused approach. Ability to work independently in a global environment. Success Measures The Workstation Engineer will be measured on: Endpoint compliance and security posture. Hardware roadmap effectiveness and lifecycle management. Patch compliance and vulnerability remediation performance. Device reliability and user experience metrics. Reduction in endpoint-related incidents. Successful delivery of endpoint modernization initiatives. Automation and operational efficiency improvements. Quality of documentation and technical standards. REQUIREMENTS: Education Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered. Experience 5+ years of experience in endpoint engineering, workstation engineering, desktop engineering, or end-user computing. Experience managing enterprise-scale Windows workstation environments. Experience with endpoint lifecycle management and hardware standardization. Experience testing and validating hardware and software compatibility. Experience managing software deployment and patch management processes. Technical Skills Windows 10/11 administration and engineering. Microsoft Intune and Endpoint Manager. Windows Autopilot. Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD). Microsoft 365 platform. PowerShell scripting and automation. Endpoint security technologies. Software packaging and deployment. Hardware lifecycle and asset management. Driver and firmware management. Device compliance and configuration management. Remote support and endpoint troubleshooting. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting macOS environments. Experience with Jamf Pro. Experience with Azure Virtual Desktop or other virtual desktop technologies. Experience with Tanium or similar endpoint management platforms. Experience with Digital Experience Monitoring (DEX/DEM) tools. ITIL Foundation certification. Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate. Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator (or successor certification). Experience operating within a regulated environment such as healthcare, clinical research, pharmaceutical, or life sciences industries. Promotion to the next level is not automatic based on years of experience. Personnel are evaluated on proven competency, level of responsibility, and ability to work independently. Track and report regression metrics over time to support continuous quality improvement. Experience working in agile, cross-functional product teams – ideally in a global or client-facing delivery context. Preferred Certifications: ISTQB Foundation Level or Advanced Level (Test Analyst / Technical Test Analyst) Playwright or Cypress official certifications (where available) Any relevant cloud or DevOps certifications (AWS, Azure, GitHub Actions) SOFT SKILLS & CULTURAL FIT Strong written and verbal communication skills – able to articulate test findings, risk assessments, and quality status clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
